title: Analyst lens: Sanofi vaccines in Taiwan

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: Thin. One post from a pregnant user recommends an infant RSV monoclonal antibody, citing NT$16,000 per dose and a 32–36 week prenatal window. The post does not name a brand and appears to blend infant antibody and prenatal dosing. A second user reports postponing an RSV shot in favour of flu. RSV volume halved week on week (15 vs 30).
products.implication: Parent-to-parent posts are shaping price perceptions and may confuse infant antibody protection with maternal options. Conversation is too small to show a demand trend.
products.action: Prepare accurate, label-based reference material on infant RSV protection pathways for healthcare professionals and medical societies. Keep monitoring parent forums for price and timing confusion. Do not engage consumers directly.
products.signal_zh: 討論稀少。一名孕婦用戶貼文推薦嬰兒RSV單株抗體，指每劑NT$16,000及產前32–36週接種時段。貼文未提品牌，且似混淆嬰兒抗體與產前接種。另一用戶表示延後RSV接種改打流感疫苗。RSV聲量較前一週減半（15對30）。
products.implication_zh: 家長間的貼文正形塑價格認知，且可能混淆嬰兒抗體保護與孕婦接種選項。討論量太小，無法顯示需求趨勢。
products.action_zh: 為醫療人員與醫學會準備以仿單為依據的嬰兒RSV保護途徑正確參考資料。持續監測家長論壇的價格與時機混淆。不直接與消費者互動。
who_zh: 新生兒與產科門診主管

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), public programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: No item this week names the high-dose vaccine, and mentions are down (hd 9 vs 13; enhanced 23 vs 42). Adjacent signals are physician coverage of flu-linked heart attack and stroke risk in over-65s and Nantou's 17 deaths, mostly older adults. CDC also plans additional flu doses, though the items do not say whether any are enhanced.
products.implication: Severity stories keep older-adult protection on the agenda while the enhanced programme itself has dropped out of the news. Questions may follow about how far enhanced doses have reached and whether top-ups include them.
products.action: Prepare an evidence pack on older-adult flu burden and real-world rollout in long-term care facilities for CDC and advisory stakeholders. Coordinate with long-term care operators and local health bureaus on rollout data. Avoid any brand comparison.
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），公費提供長照機構65歲以上長者
products.signal_zh: 本週無任何內容提及高劑量疫苗，提及量下降（高劑量9對13；加強型23對42）。相關訊號為醫師談流感導致65歲以上長者心肌梗塞與中風風險的報導，及南投17例死亡（多為長者）。疾管署亦規劃追加流感疫苗，但未說明是否含加強型。
products.implication_zh: 嚴重度報導使長者保護持續受關注，但加強型疫苗計畫本身已淡出新聞。後續可能出現加強型疫苗涵蓋程度及追加採購是否包含加強型的疑問。
products.action_zh: 為疾管署與諮詢相關人士準備長者流感疾病負擔及長照機構實際接種情形的證據資料。與長照機構業者及地方衛生局協調接種數據。避免任何品牌比較。
who_zh: 老年醫學會與心臟學會

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Nothing this week: Tdap mentions fell to zero (from 10 the previous week), and no news, social or official item addressed pertussis or Tdap.
products.implication: With the flu and COVID-19 campaign dominating attention, Tdap currently has no public visibility.
products.action: Keep baseline monitoring. Hold background material on adult and maternal pertussis protection ready for medical societies, should pertussis cases or maternal vaccination re-enter the news.
products.signal_zh: 本週無相關內容：Tdap提及量降至零（前一週為10），無任何新聞、社群或官方內容涉及百日咳或Tdap。
products.implication_zh: 流感與COVID-19疫苗接種活動吸引主要關注，Tdap目前無公眾能見度。
products.action_zh: 維持基本監測。備妥成人與孕婦百日咳保護背景資料供醫學會使用，以因應百日咳病例或孕婦接種重回新聞。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.sub: protein-based, distributed in Taiwan by Sanofi; public programme from Oct 19
products.signal: Taiwan CDC added Novavax to the public programme from October 19 and plans additional Novavax doses. Several outlets ran neutral eligibility explainers, one noting that people aged 12 and over may choose it. Social posts repeat unverified COVID-19 vaccine claims, but none in the items names Novavax.
products.implication: Launch coverage is factual and eligibility-focused, so the first weeks of uptake and any early reports will set the narrative. Generic COVID-19 misinformation could attach to a newly visible product.
products.action: Work with distribution partners, local health bureaus and contracted clinics so eligibility and access information is consistent. Prepare factual, label-based Q&A for CDC and medical journalists. Set up monitoring for Novavax-specific adverse-event or availability posts.
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質次單位疫苗，由Sanofi在台經銷；10月19日起納入公費
products.signal_zh: 疾管署自10月19日起將Novavax納入公費計畫，並規劃追加Novavax疫苗。多家媒體刊出中性的接種資格說明，其中一則指12歲以上可選擇。社群貼文重複未經證實的COVID-19疫苗說法，但均未點名Novavax。
products.implication_zh: 開打報導以事實與接種資格為主，因此最初幾週的接種情形與早期報導將定調敘事。泛COVID-19錯誤訊息可能附著於新曝光的產品。
products.action_zh: 與經銷夥伴、地方衛生局及合約院所合作，確保接種資格與可近性資訊一致。為疾管署及醫藥記者準備以仿單為依據的事實Q&A。建立針對Novavax不良事件或供應狀況貼文的監測。
who_zh: 食藥署藥物安全監視聯絡窗口

issues.title: Second-stage public flu eligibility opens as CDC tops up flu and Novavax doses
issues.note: Wider eligibility on top of demand already up 9.5% may bring allocation and stock-out questions at clinics. The extra dose orders put supply partners in view.
issues.title_zh: 公費流感第二階段開放，疾管署追加流感與Novavax疫苗
issues.note_zh: 在需求已增加9.5%之上擴大接種對象，可能引發診所配送與缺貨疑問。追加採購使供應夥伴受到關注。

issues.title: Next-wave peak, election-season clusters and SV.2.4 variant questions
issues.note: CDC next-wave estimates, Nantou death coverage and a variant detected in August could prompt media questions on older-adult coverage and on strain match.
issues.title_zh: 下一波高峰、選舉期間群聚與SV.2.4變異株疑問
issues.note_zh: 疾管署下一波預估、南投死亡報導及8月檢出的變異株，可能引發媒體詢問長者接種涵蓋率及病毒株吻合度。

issues.title: COVID-19 misinformation spilling onto newly launched products
issues.note: High-engagement Threads claims (saline, stillbirths in pregnancy) are generic for now. Prepare for brand-specific variants as the Novavax rollout gains visibility.
issues.title_zh: COVID-19錯誤訊息延燒至新上市產品
issues.note_zh: Threads高互動說法（生理食鹽水、孕期死產）目前屬泛指。隨Novavax接種能見度提高，需預備出現針對品牌的版本。

self_pay.title: Clinic fees on public flu shots
self_pay.note: A Kaohsiung user reports registration fees of NT$150–200 for a publicly funded flu shot and asks which clinic is cheapest. These are out-of-pocket costs within the public arena, not self-pay vaccine sales.
self_pay.title_zh: 公費流感疫苗的診所費用
self_pay.note_zh: 一名高雄用戶表示公費流感疫苗掛號費NT$150–200，並詢問哪家診所最便宜。此為公費領域內的自付費用，非自費疫苗銷售。

self_pay.title: Willingness to pay for a flu shot
self_pay.note: One post asks how much people would pay to get a flu shot themselves. It is a faint signal of private demand from people outside eligible groups, with no prices or clinics named.
self_pay.note_zh: 一則貼文詢問大家願意花多少錢自費打流感疫苗。此為非公費對象自費需求的微弱訊號，未提及價格或診所。

self_pay.title: Infant RSV antibody price talk
self_pay.note: A pregnant user cites NT$16,000 per dose for an infant RSV monoclonal antibody, suggesting price awareness spreads parent to parent. The post does not say where it is stocked.
self_pay.note_zh: 一名孕婦用戶指嬰兒RSV單株抗體每劑NT$16,000，顯示價格認知在家長間傳播。貼文未說明何處有貨。

self_pay.title: No signal on enhanced flu or Tdap self-pay stock
self_pay.note: Nothing this week addresses self-pay availability, stock or pricing of adjuvanted or high-dose flu vaccines or Tdap at clinics.
self_pay.title_zh: 加強型流感或Tdap自費供貨無相關訊號
self_pay.note_zh: 本週無內容涉及診所佐劑型或高劑量流感疫苗或Tdap的自費供應、庫存或價格。
